_comment: FuelBorn Hermes Agent egg — v4. Uses Hermes's native env-var schema (HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER + provider-prefixed key envs) instead of the pre-v4 generic LLM_* triple. The frontend's /api/deploy projects user-supplied credentials into the right vars; the install script writes them out to /home/container/.hermes/.env and seeds ~/.hermes/config.yaml with the chosen model.
name: Hermes Agent
author: FuelBorn
description: Nous Research Hermes Agent (github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) running inside a full Ubuntu 22.04 sandbox. The user has passwordless sudo and can install anything via apt. The agent itself is pre-installed and configured from the LLM provider variables you set at deploy time.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update >/dev/null
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates git build-essential xz-utils sudo >/dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server /mnt/server/.tmp /mnt/server/.hermes
cd /mnt/server

export TMPDIR=/mnt/server/.tmp
export HOME=/mnt/server
export HERMES_HOME=/mnt/server/.hermes
export HERMES_INSTALL_DIR=/mnt/server/hermes-agent

echo '==> Installing Hermes Agent from upstream'
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/main/scripts/install.sh \
  | bash -s -- --skip-setup --dir /mnt/server/hermes-agent

echo '==> Rewriting install-time paths from /mnt/server to /home/container'
find /mnt/server -path '*/venv/bin/*' -type f -print0 2>/dev/null \
  | xargs -0 -I{} sed -i '1s|/mnt/server/|/home/container/|g' {} 2>/dev/null || true
[ -f /mnt/server/.local/bin/hermes ] && sed -i 's|/mnt/server/|/home/container/|g' /mnt/server/.local/bin/hermes
[ -f /mnt/server/hermes-agent/venv/pyvenv.cfg ] && sed -i 's|/mnt/server/|/home/container/|g' /mnt/server/hermes-agent/venv/pyvenv.cfg
find /mnt/server -type l | while read l; do
  tgt=$(readlink "$l")
  case "$tgt" in /mnt/server/*)
    newtgt=${tgt/\/mnt\/server\//\/home\/container\/}
    ln -sfn "$newtgt" "$l"
  ;; esac
done
find /mnt/server/hermes-agent/venv/lib /mnt/server/.local/share/uv -type f \( -name '*.py' -o -name '*.pth' -o -name '*.cfg' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.toml' \) -print0 2>/dev/null \
  | xargs -0 -I{} sh -c "grep -l '/mnt/server' \"\$1\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && sed -i 's|/mnt/server/|/home/container/|g' \"\$1\"" _ {} || true
find /mnt/server -type d -name '__pycache__' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 rm -rf 2>/dev/null || true

echo '==> Seeding ~/.hermes/.env from deploy-time variables'
ENV_FILE=/mnt/server/.hermes/.env
: > "$ENV_FILE"
chmod 600 "$ENV_FILE"
# Inference provider selection (consumed by `hermes` CLI on first run).
[ -n "${HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER:-}" ] && echo "HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER=${HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER}" >> "$ENV_FILE"
# Walk every PODS_KEY_* environment var Pelican injected and emit the
# real Hermes env var (PODS_KEY_FOO=bar -> FOO=bar). This lets us add new
# providers without touching the egg JSON.
for v in $(env | awk -F= '/^PODS_KEY_/ {print $1}'); do
  real=${v#PODS_KEY_}
  val=$(printenv "$v")
  [ -n "$val" ] && echo "${real}=${val}" >> "$ENV_FILE"
done

echo '==> Writing ~/.hermes/config.yaml model default'
CFG=/mnt/server/.hermes/config.yaml
if [ -n "${HERMES_INFERENCE_MODEL:-}" ]; then
  cat > "$CFG" <<YAML
model:
  default: "${HERMES_INFERENCE_MODEL}"
  provider: "${HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER:-auto}"
YAML
  # Custom-provider path: Hermes (agent/credential_pool.py) only honours
  # provider="custom" when model.base_url + model.api_key are present in
  # config.yaml. The OPENAI_BASE_URL/OPENAI_API_KEY env vars in .hermes/.env
  # are NOT picked up for this provider — so we inject them here.
  if [ "${HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER:-}" = "custom" ]; then
    [ -n "${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ] && echo "  api_key: '${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_API_KEY}'" >> "$CFG"
    # API format toggle. Anthropic Messages picks Hermes' native
    # transport (sanitizes empty content); OpenAI Chat Completions
    # routes through the in-pod sanitizer proxy that pads empty
    # blocks before they reach the upstream Claude relay.
    case "${PODS_KEY_HERMES_API_MODE:-openai}" in
      anthropic)
        [ -n "${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_BASE_URL:-}" ] && echo "  base_url: '${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_BASE_URL}'" >> "$CFG"
        echo "  api_mode: anthropic_messages" >> "$CFG"
        [ -n "${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ] && echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_API_KEY}" >> "$ENV_FILE"
        [ -n "${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_BASE_URL:-}" ] && echo "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_BASE_URL%/v1}" >> "$ENV_FILE"
        ;;
      *)
        echo "  base_url: 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1'" >> "$CFG"
        echo "  api_mode: chat_completions" >> "$CFG"
        # Sanitizer reads the real upstream from this env file at
        # boot — the frontend's wireHermesProxy drops sanitizer.py +
        # sanitizer.sh into .pods/ post-install, and the patched
        # pods-ml-pod-init.sh runs sanitizer.sh on every container
        # start.
        mkdir -p /mnt/server/.pods
        echo "PODS_SANITIZER_UPSTREAM=${PODS_KEY_OPENAI_BASE_URL%/v1}" > /mnt/server/.pods/sanitizer.env
        echo "PODS_SANITIZER_PORT=8765" >> /mnt/server/.pods/sanitizer.env
        chmod 600 /mnt/server/.pods/sanitizer.env
        ;;
    esac
  fi
  cat >> "$CFG" <<YAML
auxiliary:
  compression:
    provider: main
YAML
fi

echo '==> Pre-installing WhatsApp bridge dependencies (Baileys + libsignal-node)'
# Doing this in the Pelican install container avoids OOM at runtime: the
# install container gets a bigger memory budget than the user pod, and
# Baileys pulls libsignal-node from git which spikes RAM during prepare.
BRIDGE=/mnt/server/hermes-agent/scripts/whatsapp-bridge
if [ -d "$BRIDGE" ] && [ ! -d "$BRIDGE/node_modules/@whiskeysockets/baileys" ]; then
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then NPM_BIN=npm;
  elif [ -x /mnt/server/.hermes/node/bin/npm ]; then NPM_BIN=/mnt/server/.hermes/node/bin/npm; export PATH=/mnt/server/.hermes/node/bin:$PATH;
  else NPM_BIN=""; fi
  if [ -n "$NPM_BIN" ]; then
    (cd "$BRIDGE" && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=2048" $NPM_BIN install --silent --no-audit --no-fund --maxsockets=4 2>&1 | tail -10) || echo "warning: bridge npm install returned non-zero — pairing wizard will retry at first use"
  else
    echo "warning: no npm found at install time — bridge will install at first pairing"
  fi
fi

echo '==> Hermes Agent install complete'

variables.name: Hermes inference provider
variables.description: Slug Hermes uses to pick a provider (openrouter, anthropic, openai-codex, gemini, novita, deepseek, xai, …). The frontend writes the matching API-key env vars; you can change provider later from the pod's Settings tab or by running `hermes setup` inside the pod.

variables.name: Default model
variables.description: Model id seeded into ~/.hermes/config.yaml (model.default). Change later with `hermes model` inside the pod.

variables.name: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: API key for OpenRouter, written to ~/.hermes/.env as OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

variables.name: Nous Portal API key
variables.description: API key for Nous Portal — written as NOUS_API_KEY.

variables.name: OpenAI API key
variables.description: OPENAI_API_KEY for api.openai.com (also used for custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints).

variables.name: OpenAI base URL
variables.description: Optional OPENAI_BASE_URL override (used by the Custom provider).

variables.name: Google AI Studio API key
variables.description: GOOGLE_API_KEY for Gemini via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

variables.name: Alibaba DashScope API key
variables.description: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY for Qwen via Alibaba Model Studio.
